description: Use this when the person asks whether something Andru started is done: an asset from generate_asset, a brief from generate_portfolio_brief, or an account plan from get_account_plan. While it is building you get its progress; when it is done you get the asset or brief in full as markdown, or the plan's link and summary (all saved to their Andru account).

job_id.description: The job_id returned by generate_asset, generate_portfolio_brief or get_account_plan.

name: get_asset
title: Collect a finished result
